errors.evidence: This sentence misassigns values and colors. The chart has blue Per-Output and orange Per-Layer bars at sparsity rates 10% through 80%; there is no cyan series, and the bars are not labeled with percentages as values.

errors.text_span: 图表没有按特定方式排序
errors.evidence: The bars are ordered by increasing sparsity rate from 10% to 80%, so the chart is explicitly ordered.

errors.evidence: The figure does not visually emphasize the blue bars beyond being one of the two series; there is no special highlighting indicated.

errors.text_span: The blue bar reaches a value of approximately 8,000 at 70% sparsity
errors.evidence: At 70% sparsity, the blue Per-Output bar is around 20, not 8,000; 8,000 is far above the plotted range (which tops out near 10^3).

errors.evidence: At 50% sparsity, the orange Per-Layer bar is around 7–8, not 10.

errors.text_span: The blue bar is consistently taller than the orange bar across the entire range of sparsity rates
errors.evidence: This is false: the orange Per-Layer bars are taller than the blue Per-Output bars at 50%, 60%, 70%, and 80% sparsity.

errors.text_span: Die X-Achse stellt die Sparsity-Rate dar, die in 10%-, 20%-, 30%-, 40%-, 50%-, 60%-, 70%-, 80% Bedeutungen enthält.
errors.evidence: The x-axis is labeled 'Sparsity Rate' and shows categories 10%, 20%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70%, 80%, but the phrasing 'Bedeutungen enthält' is incorrect and awkward; more importantly the axis description omits that these are tick labels/categories rather than 'meanings'.

errors.text_span: Der längste blaue Balken entspricht etwa 9,5, während der kürzeste Blaue-Balken etwa 6,5 entspricht. Der längste orange Balken entspricht etwa 7,5, während der kürzeste orange Balken etwa 5,5 entspricht.
errors.evidence: The bars are on a log-scaled axis and the largest values are around 500–900 at 80% sparsity, while the smallest values are around 5–6 at 10% sparsity. The stated maxima of 9.5 and 7.5 are far too low and do not match the chart.
The description does not correctly mention the logarithmic scale/tick marks on the y-axis (10^1, 10^2, 10^3), which are essential to interpret the chart.
The description does not mention that each sparsity rate is shown as a side-by-side bar pair, with blue bars on the left and orange bars on the right.
This phrase is ungrammatical and unclear in German; it does not cleanly describe the x-axis categories.
